conclusion: NO ADSKLIB write or export route exists in the Revit API. The keyword scan matched on the substring library, but every hit is Get/SetLibraryPaths, which are the FAMILY CONTENT library search paths shown in File Locations (Imperial Library, Metric Library), not material libraries. UpdateRenderAppearanceLibrary refreshes the appearance library in session; it does not author or export one. The probe script auto-set a positive conclusion from a keyword hit; that was a false positive and is corrected here.
false_positive_note: Recorded deliberately: an automated conclusion string was wrong and the raw member list is what disproves it. Keep both.
